name: paraphrase
description: Questions worded without the answer's vocabulary, over short policy documents and lexical decoys that share the questions' surface words.

docs.title: Refund policy
docs.text:
# Refund policy

Refunds are issued within 45 days of purchase to the original payment method. After 45 days, purchases can only be exchanged for store credit.

docs.title: Account recovery
docs.text:
# Account recovery

To reset a forgotten password, open Settings, choose Security, and select Reset password. A reset link is emailed to the address on file and expires after one hour.

docs.title: Delivery times
docs.text:
# Delivery times

Standard orders ship within two business days and usually arrive in three to five days. Express delivery arrives the next business day for an extra fee.

docs.title: Paid leave
docs.text:
# Paid leave

Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of paid leave per month, up to 30 days. Unused leave carries over into the first quarter of the next year.

docs.title: Data retention
docs.text:
# Data retention

Application logs are deleted after 30 days. Database backups are kept for 90 days and then destroyed.

docs.title: Cafeteria menu labels
docs.text:
# Cafeteria menu labels

Dishes containing peanuts, tree nuts, or shellfish are marked with a red triangle on the menu board.

docs.title: Expense reimbursement
docs.text:
# Expense reimbursement

Submit receipts in the finance portal within 30 days. Reimbursements are paid with the next payroll run.

docs.title: Visitor parking
docs.text:
# Visitor parking

Visitors park on level 2 of the garage and get their ticket validated at reception.

docs.title: Incident response
docs.text:
# Incident response

If production is down, page the on-call engineer through the alerting tool and open an incident channel.

docs.title: Hardware refresh
docs.text:
# Hardware refresh

Company laptops are replaced every three years. Request a replacement early if yours fails the diagnostics check.

docs.title: Working from home
docs.text:
# Working from home

Staff may work remotely up to three days a week with their manager's approval.

docs.title: Lost badges
docs.text:
# Lost badges

Report a lost access card to security immediately; it is deactivated within ten minutes and a replacement is printed at the front desk.

docs.title: Pull request reviews
docs.text:
# Pull request reviews

Every pull request needs approval from one code owner before merge, and CI must be green.

docs.title: First week
docs.text:
# First week

New hires receive their equipment on day one and meet their mentor on day two.

docs.title: Printing
docs.text:
# Printing

The color printer on floor 3 requires your badge to release jobs.

docs.title: Business travel
docs.text:
# Business travel

Flights and hotels must be booked through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead.

docs.title: Illness
docs.text:
# Illness

If you are unwell, tell your manager before 10am; a doctor's note is required after three consecutive days.

docs.title: Animals at the office
docs.text:
# Animals at the office

Dogs are welcome on Fridays if they are house-trained and stay in the designated area.

docs.title: Two-step verification
docs.text:
# Two-step verification

Enable two-step verification with an authenticator app; text-message codes are no longer accepted.

docs.title: Billing disputes
docs.text:
# Billing disputes

If an invoice looks wrong, reply to the billing email within 60 days and a specialist will review the charges.

docs.title: Money transfers
docs.text:
# Money transfers

You can send money back and forth between linked accounts, up to 2,000 dollars per day.

docs.title: Sign-in page redesign
docs.text:
# Sign-in page redesign

The sign-in page now remembers your username on trusted devices, so you can sign in faster.

docs.title: Package manager
docs.text:
# Package manager

The build uses a lockfile so every package version is pinned; a package update shows up in the diff.

docs.title: Time tracking
docs.text:
# Time tracking

Log the time you spend on each project in the time tracker by Friday each month.

docs.title: Records management training
docs.text:
# Records management training

All staff must complete the records management course once a year; old records training certificates are stored in the portal.

docs.title: Guest Wi-Fi
docs.text:
# Guest Wi-Fi

A guest can join the network named Lobby with the password printed at reception.

docs.title: Website analytics
docs.text:
# Website analytics

The website traffic dashboard stopped updating last week; contact the analytics team for the raw numbers.

docs.title: Housing assistance
docs.text:
# Housing assistance

The relocation team shares apartment listings for new hires moving to the city.

docs.title: Lobby doors
docs.text:
# Lobby doors

The automatic doors in the lobby are serviced every spring and open on their own.

docs.title: Model plane club
docs.text:
# Model plane club

The model plane club meets on Thursdays to build a new plane kit.

docs.title: Medical plan
docs.text:
# Medical plan

The medical plan covers two dental cleanings a year and a yearly eye exam.

docs.title: Shelter volunteering
docs.text:
# Shelter volunteering

Volunteers collect donations at the animal shelter, where a puppy adoption day runs each spring.

docs.title: SMS alerts
docs.text:
# SMS alerts

Subscribe to SMS alerts to hear about building closures and severe weather.

docs.title: Electric vehicles
docs.text:
# Electric vehicles

Electric car charging stations on level 1 are free for employees who leave their car there.

docs.title: Conference rooms
docs.text:
# Conference rooms

Reserve a conference room through the calendar; the big room needs a ticket to facilities.

docs.title: Recycling electronics
docs.text:
# Recycling electronics

Drop old computer accessories, cables, and keyboards in the recycling bin by the loading dock.
